set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "STEP 1: create service user"

sudo -n mkdir -p /opt/inventory-api /var/lib/inventory-api
sudo -n chown inventory:inventory /var/lib/inventory-api

echo "STEP 2: write app"
sudo -n tee /opt/inventory-api/app.py >/dev/null <<'PYEOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, os, time
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

DATA_FILE = "/var/lib/inventory-api/inventory.json"
START = time.time()

def load_data():
    if os.path.exists(DATA_FILE):
        with open(DATA_FILE) as f:
            return json.load(f)
    data = {"items": [
        {"sku": "A100", "name": "Widget", "qty": 42},
        {"sku": "B200", "name": "Gadget", "qty": 17},
    ]}
    save_data(data)
    return data

def save_data(data):
    tmp = DATA_FILE + ".tmp"
    with open(tmp, "w") as f:
        json.dump(data, f)
    os.replace(tmp, DATA_FILE)

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def _json(self, code, obj):
        body = json.dumps(obj).encode()
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            self._json(200, {"status": "ok", "pid": os.getpid(), "uptime": time.time() - START})
        elif self.path == "/inventory":
            self._json(200, load_data())
        else:
            self._json(404, {"error": "not found"})

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    load_data()
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler)
    server.serve_forever()
PYEOF
sudo -n chown root:root /opt/inventory-api/app.py
sudo -n chmod 755 /opt/inventory-api/app.py

echo "STEP 3: write systemd unit with OOM protection"
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service >/dev/null <<'UNITEOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory API service
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventory
Group=inventory
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory-api/app.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=2
# Protect this critical service from the kernel OOM killer: -1000 means
# the kernel will never select this process as an OOM victim.
OOMScoreAdjust=-1000
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory-api

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNITEOF

sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-api.service

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os, time, sys
print("memhog starting pid=%d" % os.getpid(), flush=True)
chunks = []
chunk_size = 20 * 1024 * 1024  # 20MB
total = 0
try:
    while True:
        b = bytearray(chunk_size)
        # touch every page to force real RSS allocation
        for i in range(0, chunk_size, 4096):
            b[i] = 1
        chunks.append(b)
        total += chunk_size
        print("memhog allocated_mb=%d" % (total // (1024*1024)), flush=True)
        time.sleep(0.1)
except MemoryError:
    print("memhog got MemoryError at_mb=%d" % (total // (1024*1024)), flush=True)
    time.sleep(60)
PYEOF
